definitions.explanation: The judge who leads and presides over court proceedings.

examples.japanese: {裁判長|さいばんちょう}が{判決|はんけつ}を{言|い}い{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: The presiding judge delivered the verdict.

examples.japanese: {裁判長|さいばんちょう}、{異議|いぎ}があります。
examples.english: Your Honor, I have an objection.

examples.japanese: {裁判長|さいばんちょう}が{開廷|かいてい}を{宣言|せんげん}した。
examples.english: The presiding judge declared the court in session.

notes:
{裁判長|さいばんちょう} is the judge who leads court proceedings.

ROLE OF THE PRESIDING JUDGE:
- Maintains order in the courtroom
- Manages the flow of the trial
- Delivers the final verdict in many cases

RELATED TERMS:
- {裁判官|さいばんかん} (judge - general term)
- {裁判所|さいばんしょ} (court/courthouse)
- {陪審員|ばいしんいん} (juror)
